competing_hypotheses: The diff accidentally changed `if target_type and target_type != type(cleaned):` to `if target_type or target_type != type(cleaned):` in `strip_ansi`. When passed a standard `str`, `target_type` is `None`, causing `target_type != type(cleaned)` to evaluate to `True` and leading to a `TypeError` when attempting to call `None`. The commit message [msg:bba729bf4539] confirms the commit was intended for `MultiReplace` performance improvements, making this change an unintended regression.
